name: trusted-hands
description: Trusted Hands — Local Services Marketplace Foundation & Design System

scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan,emerald" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm run postinstall && npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
